headline: Callahan's Passage Blazes Anew as Weathered Expanse Cools
war_summary: Callahan's Passage has seized the ledger since our last edition: thirteen base actions in the day's count and three more within the closing two hours, the last logged at the very press hour, Colonial losses running near seven hundred sixty to the hour against Warden returns near six hundred, Crumbling Post the hardest pressed. Kuura Strand is scarcely quieter, three actions in the final watches and better than six hundred casualties a side in two hours, the fighting turning on Suosalo, Talven and Menneen. Palantine Berm filed the freshest dispatch, five actions in two hours about the Pippeli Stones, its score five Warden bases to one Colonial with one post in ruins. The Weathered Expanse, until now the busiest front, has logged no action in two hours and its casualty rate has cooled sharply; the Nevish Line likewise quiets. The Stlican Shelf still turns about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, Mooring County's returns climb past six hundred a side in two hours near The Wind Hills, and Oarbreaker's Grisly Refuge went neutral and was reclaimed. Elsewhere the map rests. It is day 463; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
